current.title: Current wager

rules.title: Table rules
rules.comeOut: Pass Line wins on 7 or 11 and loses on 2, 3, or 12 during the come-out roll.
rules.point: When a point is set, Pass Line wins by repeating the point before 7; Don't Pass reverses that result.
rules.dontPush: Don't Pass returns the wager when the come-out total is 12.
errors.wagerRequired: Enter 0.01 to 100,000 play tokens using exact cent increments.
errors.startFailed: The wager could not be confirmed. Retry to recover the same action safely.
errors.rollFailed: The roll could not be confirmed. Retry to recover the same action safely.
